label: Complete inaugural season record
note: Public-source snapshot. The 2026 regular season and inaugural championship are complete. Regular-season standings remain separated from the title-game result, and league honors are sourced from official UPSHOT team announcements.

championship.detail: Charlotte erased a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit and outscored Jacksonville 32-19 in the final period.

teams.note: Jacksonville won the inaugural regular-season table and hosted the first championship. The Waves led Charlotte through three quarters before the Crown's fourth-quarter comeback ended the title game 81-76.

Charlotte turned a 1-5 start into a championship story. The Crown closed the regular season 22-6 after Schaquilla Nunn joined, then rallied from 10 down in the fourth quarter to win the inaugural title 81-76.

teams.arena: Novant Health Fieldhouse / First Horizon Coliseum
teams.note: Greensboro finished third in year one. The Groove's inaugural season included statement wins, All-UPSHOT guard Diamond Johnson and one of the league's first WNBA call-ups in Christyn Williams.
Savannah closed the regular season with a 92-90 win over first-place Jacksonville. Lasha Petree gave the Steel a place on the inaugural All-UPSHOT Team.

expansionTeams.detail: The fifth UPSHOT franchise begins play in May 2027. Its permanent team name, logo, colors, uniforms, mascot and head coach remain pending.
The sixth UPSHOT franchise begins play in May 2027, with Nancy VanReece serving as president and CEO. Its permanent team identity remains pending.

timeline.title: The league is announced
timeline.detail: Zawyer Sports & Entertainment announces a new professional women's basketball league headquartered in Jacksonville, with play targeted for May 2026.

timeline.title: The Founding Four get identities
timeline.detail: Savannah Steel, Jacksonville Waves, Charlotte Crown and Greensboro Groove are unveiled as the inaugural clubs.

timeline.title: Opening tip
timeline.detail: UPSHOT's first regular-season games are played: Savannah at Greensboro and Charlotte at Jacksonville.

timeline.title: First WNBA call-up
timeline.detail: Charlotte Crown forward Michelle Onyiah becomes the first UPSHOT player to earn a WNBA contract.

timeline.title: A second door opens
timeline.detail: Greensboro guard Christyn Williams signs with the Dallas Wings, becoming the second inaugural-season UPSHOT-to-WNBA move.

timeline.title: Regular season complete
timeline.detail: Jacksonville finishes first at 25-9, Charlotte second at 23-11, and the championship field is set.

timeline.title: Charlotte wins the first championship
timeline.detail: The Crown erase a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit, beat Jacksonville 81-76 and become the first UPSHOT champions. Deja Kelly earns Championship MVP with 29 points and six rebounds.

timeline.title: The inaugural honors are announced
timeline.detail: Ariel Hearn wins league MVP, Schaquilla Nunn wins Defensive Player of the Year, Taylor Soule wins Sixth Woman and six players make the first All-UPSHOT Team.
